title: Secured lending perfection bundle
description: Filing preparation, guaranty, and syndicated-credit evidence before an irreversible lending act.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: fs-secured-lending-perfection
  title: Secured lending perfection bundle
  description: Filing preparation, guaranty, and syndicated-credit evidence before an irreversible lending act.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-04
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/financial-services
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [regulatory_filing.filing_number, guaranty.guarantor_name, loan_facility.total_commitment_amount, credit_agreement.agreement_date]
      relationshipIds: [obligated_under, supported_by, reported_through]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/ucc_financing_statement, role: completion }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/fs/guaranty_agreement, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/fs/syndicated_credit_agreement, role: supporting }
